items.title: Johnny Lala Interview, 1958-09-24
items.q: Jules and I all keep together. Started out Jules Casdard. Henry Brunas. Well, Henry came after.

ctx.x: Yes. Yes. He travels with the races or something.

That's what I would, yeah. Yeah. Somebody's on. Jules and I all keep together. Started out Jules Casdard. Henry Brunas. Well, Henry came after. He was here. Eddie Edwards. And what's his name that died? Yellow Lunez. Remember what? Yellow Lunez.
I've got lots of his records.
